Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Walk in and talk to a pharmacist at KSL City Mall, no appointment needed. That is our Minute Consult. Open daily, 10AM to 10PM, at Lot G-001, Ground Floor, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. In Episode 13 of our Uncle Lim family story, Uncle Ong carries a giant jar of salted vegetables into Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, along with a message saying sea salt has no limit. Our pharmacist does not argue. He asks one question: what did you eat yesterday? By the time Uncle Ong counts the salted egg, the kiam chye and the soy sauce on everything, he has run out of fingers. Three easy habits for your next meal in Johor Bahru: ask for the sauce on the side, taste before adding anything, and leave the last of the soup in the bowl. Got a forwarded health message or a food label you are unsure about? Bring it in. A quick chat with our pharmacist takes only a few minutes, and your doctor's plan always comes first.

标题 Title (≤20)
爸爸的朋友抱着一罐咸菜来药房😂
正文 Note
上个月我爸被群组里的“神奇果汁”转发骗去买了十二条苦瓜。 今天，发那条转发的 Ong 叔叔终于来新山 KSL 了！ 他抱着一大罐自家腌的咸菜，走进 Alpro 药房，说要找那个问他“这信息是谁写的”的药剂师 🫙 最好笑的是：我爸在旁边教训他，语气跟我以前教训我爸一模一样…… 药剂师没有跟他争，只问了一句： “叔叔，昨天吃了什么？从早餐开始讲。” 咸蛋、咸菜、什么都淋酱青……Ong 叔叔手指都数不够了。 后来他小声说，阿姨走了以后，吃东西都没味道。 第二天在咖啡店，他自己点面，酱料另外放一小碟。我爸拍拍旁边的椅子，帮他留了位子 🥹 💡 三个减盐小习惯： 1️⃣ 酱料另外放，蘸着吃 2️⃣ 先尝两口再加 3️⃣ 面汤不用喝到见底 4️⃣ 多用姜、蒜、香茅、酸柑提味 （世卫建议成人每天盐不超过约一茶匙） 📍 Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall（新山 KSL 商场底楼 Lot G-001） 每天上午10点至晚上10点 有健康疑问或看不懂的转发信息，欢迎直接到店问药剂师，不用预约 😊
